source: Local UE4SS object dump and separately recorded demo integration checks. Not a live SDK or full-game API guarantee.

entries.title: GetCompatibleMountsRecursive
entries.role: Mount-compatibility lookup used by the expanded attachment-list integration.
entries.signature: Mounts and an output name array; inspect wrapper/output semantics.
entries.notes: Recorded lookup expansion and menu checks do not validate every possible assembly.

entries.title: OnGetUserMenuContent
entries.signature: Widget return value in the schema; recorded Blueprint post callback did not supply it as first expected.
entries.notes: The local tab code used the stored AttachmentsList property instead.

entries.title: SetupAttachment
entries.role: Fit an attachment class or take the native removal path.
entries.signature: Attachment is a class reference; nil removed the test child.
entries.notes: Synthetic removal/batch fixtures passed; all real saved assemblies were not covered.

entries.title: UpdateWeaponEditDisplay
entries.role: Editor refresh point used by control-lifecycle code.
entries.signature: Context observed; inspect full current signature before using additional inputs.
entries.notes: A refresh can rebuild point/widget references.

entries.title: EnterWeaponEditMode
entries.signature: Context observed; this catalog does not reconstruct all inputs.
entries.notes: Used to align custom control visibility with the actual mode.

entries.title: LeaveWeaponEditMode
entries.signature: Context observed; inspect the current owning class/signature.
entries.notes: Pending context-dependent actions must cancel on exit.

entries.title: UpdateCharacteristicsFromParts
entries.role: Recalculate selected groups of derived characteristics.
entries.signature: Nine booleans: Weight, Ergo, CenterMassLoc, Recoil, GripCenter, BarrelLength, EquippedScopeAndLaser, Cooling, TotalLength.
entries.notes: A mutating gameplay recalculation, not simply a redraw call.

entries.title: ProcessBulletFired
entries.role: Firing event used for shot identity and projectile capture.
entries.signature: Cartridge, two recoil forces, recoil location/direction, Barrel, PowderAmount, ExitPressure, PowderType, Bullet array.
entries.notes: Hook resolution/local native integration does not prove every real-peer firing scenario.

entries.title: RegisterHit
entries.role: Bullet-level impact entry used by local impact capture.
entries.signature: ImpactInfo struct; copy needed ordinary values within the callback.
entries.notes: An impact is not automatically an accepted scoring target hit.

entries.title: CurrentEnergyInJoules
entries.role: An energy-named native function with a surface-type input, discovered in the schema.
entries.signature: SurfaceType enum input and a float return in the inspected dump; verify the enum domain before calling.
entries.notes: Not a proven zero-argument raw-energy getter or a recovered ballistic formula; no fresh runtime call in this documentation pass.

entries.title: TargetBase Hit
entries.role: Target-side path used to connect a bullet to the target.
entries.signature: Observed capture uses impact info, player, velocity, stance and bullet context; confirm exact current names/types.
entries.notes: Keep attribution separate from the valid-hit award decision.

entries.title: TargetBase OnHit
entries.signature: ValidHit, Player, ImpactInfo, HitEnergy, HitVelocity, TriggeredBonus, TriggeredCartUnlock, BreakingHit.
entries.notes: Replaying reward paths for remote cosmetics can duplicate progression.

entries.title: CharacterTargetBase Hit
entries.signature: Inspect the current derived-class signature; do not assume one base callback covers every class.
entries.notes: Deduplicate if a single action reaches more than one observed handler.

entries.title: CharacterTargetBase OnHit
entries.signature: The inspected result has validity/player/impact/energy/velocity/bonus/unlock/breaking fields.
entries.notes: Local native callback checks are narrower than universal target support.

entries.title: ReleaseMagazine
entries.signature: Weapon context is used; confirm remaining signature in the current build.
entries.notes: Do not count every related class release function as a distinct reload.

entries.title: OnSnappedToSlot
entries.signature: Part context is used with a validated ParentWeapon reference.
entries.notes: A cosmetic reload event is not proof every inventory/feed operation completed.

entries.title: SetAiming
entries.signature: NewAiming boolean observed in the schema.
entries.notes: Do not assume calling it alone reproduces the pawn/camera/stance flow.

entries.title: GetCurrentErgo
entries.role: Part-level ergonomics getter name in the native schema.
entries.signature: Float return observed.
entries.notes: Part getter, current weapon total and installed total are different references.

entries.title: PreConstruct
entries.signature: Inspect the actual loaded class and current preconstruct signature.
entries.notes: A visible card does not prove its destination map is usable.

entries.title: SetSelected
entries.signature: Selection/context observed; verify current inputs before writing selection.
entries.notes: Recorded custom-card work eventually opened the existing pool world.
